customManagers.description: WezTerm, built from a snapshot of main: REF stays main and Renovate moves DIGEST to main's newest commit. What the build verifies beside DIGEST (SHA256, COMMITTED, each submodule's _DIGEST and _SHA256, and gitlinks.json) follows from the commit, and .github/workflows/pins-bot.yml writes it on the PR's branch.
The Rust toolchain the build compiles with (components/rust/version; rust on 10.9, rust-cross on a modern Mac). build/tools.sh refuses an installed release other than the pin.
The clang22 that compiles and links the build's C and C++ (components/clang22/version; clang22 on 10.9, clang22-cross on a modern Mac). build/tools.sh refuses an installed release other than the pin.
The GNU make the vendored OpenSSL builds with (components/make/version). build/tools.sh refuses an installed release other than the pin.

Longboat, which CI installs to get the 10.9 SDK the clang22 pkgs require (components/longboat/version, CI-only). Longboat tags YYYYMMDD.N; the versioning reads N as the minor, so two releases on one day order.

packageRules.description: One WezTerm snapshot a week, not one per commit to main: each bump is a release, and the pins bot downloads five tarballs for it.
prBodyNotes: **The pins beside DIGEST:** `.github/workflows/pins-bot.yml` writes `SHA256`, `COMMITTED`, each submodule's `_DIGEST` and `_SHA256` and `components/wezterm/gitlinks.json` on this branch, after checking with git that each tarball is its commit's tree. Until then the build fails at the first fetch. If the bot failed, run `sh scripts/pin-source-tarballs.sh --fill` on this branch and push what it writes.

packageRules.description: Renovate moves components/clang22/version but cannot write the Linux archive's digest beside it, which fetch_clang22.sh needs on Linux.
prBodyNotes: Before this can merge, replace components/clang22/linux-sha256 with the `clang22-<version>-linux-x86_64.tar.gz` line of the new release's SHA256SUMS: `gh release download <version> -R Mavergreen/clang-22 -p SHA256SUMS -O - | grep linux-x86_64.tar.gz > components/clang22/linux-sha256`.
